resolved: “The vendor portal's exact attribution of the surrogate bid as buyer-added versus the vendor's own bid cannot be asserted” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

resolved: “Whether Vendor A can revise the surrogate bid when enable_surrogate_revise_bid is Off cannot be directly asserted becaus” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's Participants tab, as required for a prepared no-bid event.
Ensure the case's surrogate-revision configuration is disabled.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the setup.
Place the buyer-entered bid for Vendor A.
Verify that the surrogate bid was accepted and submitted.
Open the separate supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open the event's pricing round in Vendor A's portal to inspect the vendor-visible bid state.
Record the vendor portal screen for the surrogate bid's displayed attribution and available revision controls.
Assert that Vendor A's pricing round shows the bid as submitted.
